# Research method and reading guide

<!-- Generated by tools/research/research.py render. Edit records or scoped goals, not this view. -->

[Home](../README.md) · [Results](../RESULTS.md) · [Scopes](../GOALS.md) · [Connections](../DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Open questions](../OPEN-QUESTIONS.md) · [Contribute](RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)

Canonical entry: [The Theory of Becoming](../theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md), with its premise card, the theory without axiom (sections 1–6), the conditional section 6.15, the formal spine and the place of earlier chapters. [The work board](BECOMING-WORKBOARD.md) holds claims and the landing queue.

We investigate how relations form, persist and change within one unfolding of becoming, and how organization, living, knowing, learning, evaluation and wisdom differentiate within it. Real losses, distinct scopes and counterexamples remain explicit; success in a local model does not by itself establish a universal warrant.

Read [the shared method](../theories/becoming/chapters/NONDUAL-METHOD.md) before foundational work. [Working rules](../AGENTS.md) apply throughout; [the scope directory](../GOALS.md) preserves independently authorized goals.

| Location | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `theories/` | Current argument and interpretation |
| `_process/research/` | Existing studies, critique and integration evidence |
| `experiments/` | Working formal sources, experiments and retained build evidence |
| `sources/` | Original material and provenance |
| `tools/research/` | Shared navigation, validation and discovery |

<a id="discovery-and-evidence--检索与证据"></a>
## Discovery and evidence

[Full reading catalogue](../theories/becoming/results/README.md) · [Curated generativity chain](../theories/becoming/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md) · [Dated session map](../theories/becoming/results/SESSION-RESULTS.md) · [Broader theory map](../MAP.md)

```sh
make research-check
make research-find QUERY=your-topic
make research-render
```

Default discovery excludes frozen copies and failed build attempts. Use `--archives` deliberately to include them. Checks concern metadata and evidence bindings; mathematical changes retain their actual Lean-build requirement.
